description: Source code for redis-benchmark, a utility to benchmark Redis server performance by executing various Redis commands and measuring latency and throughput.

methods.name: freeClient
methods.description: Frees resources associated with a client and removes it from the client list.

methods.name: freeAllClients
methods.description: Frees all clients in the global client list.

methods.name: resetClient
methods.description: Resets a client to be ready for a new request.

methods.name: randomizeClientKey
methods.description: Randomizes key parts in the client's command buffer.

methods.name: clientDone
methods.description: Handles completion of a client request, freeing or resetting as needed.

methods.name: readHandler
methods.description: Handles read events from Redis server, processes replies.

methods.name: writeHandler
methods.description: Handles write events to Redis server, sends commands.

methods.name: createClient
methods.description: Creates and initializes a new Redis client, prepares command buffer.

methods.name: createMissingClients
methods.description: Creates additional clients to reach desired concurrency.

methods.name: showLatencyReport
methods.description: Displays latency distribution and throughput statistics.

methods.name: benchmark
methods.description: Runs a benchmark test with specified command and reports results.

methods.name: parseOptions
methods.description: Parses command-line options for benchmark configuration.

methods.name: showThroughput
methods.description: Periodically displays current throughput during benchmark.

methods.name: test_is_selected
methods.description: Checks if a specific test is selected based on command-line arguments.
